schemes.description: Immutable content by CID. resources/read returns file bytes (text or blob, capped like ipfs_cat) or a directory listing as JSON. Tools return these URIs in resource_link blocks for large or directory results.
Mutable content by IPNS name or DNSLink domain, resolved at read time through the daemon.
MCP App views (SEP-1865) embedded with go:embed and linked from tools through _meta.ui. Content Security Policy default-src 'none' widened only to bundled assets; no remote origins.
